judged_text: limit and offset are unvalidated .to_i casts on a public endpoint: negative values produce invalid SQL OFFSET/LIMIT (500), and an arbitrarily large limit removes the row cap entirely. offset=-1 on /groups/:name/members raises a Postgres error surfaced as a 500 on a public page; limit=1000000 lets any visitor materialize an entire group's member set serialized in one response, re-opening the unbounded-materialization path this change was meant to close.

adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members` (public endpoint), `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` are used directly in `group.users...limit(limit).offset(offset)` with no validation/clamping. From the diff, negative `offset` can reach ActiveRecord/Postgres (`OFFSET -1`) and plausibly raise an error (500). Likewise, an arbitrarily large (or negative) `limit` can remove practical row caps and allow very large member-set materialization/serialization in one response. The client-side `Group.findMembers` clamps offset, but the server endpoint remains unprotected for direct requests.
